title: Normalization of the specified integral unit purity orientation
statement: Use [def-pod-normalized-coefficient-units], [def-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality-data], [def-pur-canonical-rational-purity-realization], [def-pur-unit-trace-reduction-data] and [def-pur-completed-unit-pullback-data]. Let P be the stipulated finite-field and coefficient setting, a_X:X->Spec(k) smooth separated of pure dimension d between the stated finite-type schemes, T its normalized exceptional/compact-support coefficient system, and I the specified simultaneous integral smooth-purity family for T. For a literal finite subfield E of the fixed coefficient closure and the normalized completed-unit pullback core, identify the source of I.gamma_E at the completed coefficient unit with the shifted Tate line by the actual completed-unit pullback and tensor unitor. Define the normalization predicate by equality of this transported I.gamma_E with the unique trace-normalized orientation of the canonical rational-purity realization, and the inverse equality for the same arrows. This specifies the relation between the stipulated reconstructed family and the published rational/common-stage realization; it proves no normalization.

Explicit exchange equation TY.map e ≫ R_Q = δ_{Q,C} ≫ D_s(u_Q⁻¹) ≫ e' for site-perfect K at every transition, with admissibility as hypotheses; e pinned by StageConclusion.components.
